text:
alex_k: Q1 hosted-api capacity draft — proposing an adaptive burst + commit mix instead of a straight lease. Base commit: 120 A100h-equivalent reserved. Burst pool: target 35-45% of peak as short-term rentals. Napkin calc below, looking for ops/finance sanity checks. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

priya_m: Can you paste the napkin numbers? curious about per-token cost delta if we push more batching/quant. :thinking_face:

alex_k: sure — rough numbers:
```
Assumptions:
- Peak 90th pct sustained tokens/day -> 1.8B tokens
- Avg throughput target -> 70k tok/s across fleet
- A100h equiv reserved = 120 units -> ~9.5k tok/s reserved steady (with batching)
- Burst rental capacity (35%) ~ additional 25k tok/s when needed
Costs:
- Reserved (committed) monthly amortized = $Xk per unit
- Rental burst = 2.5x spot hourly cost but flexible
Tradeoff: commit lowers marginal token cost ~15-20% at baseline, burst covers tail.
```

mateo_r: Where did the 70k tok/s target come from? recent telemetry shows 60k median but strong tail spikes in marketing campaigns during product launches. We should model 95th pct.

alex_k: Right — 70k is 95th-ish with projected growth + one large enterprise onboarded in Q1. I can attach sim later.

casey_ops: Regional note: EU capacity is constrained for Q1 due to limited rack slots at partner colo. If we push more commit for EU, we need to shift some reserved to US and rely on cross-region routing for failover. That adds egress latency ~40-80ms for some customers.

jordan_r: For quality, if we shift more to quantized variants in reserve we need an eval matrix. We can't just quantize everything — some customers need fp16. We should reserve a small pool of fp16 GPUs pinned to enterprise models.

priya_m: Agree. Also can we reduce commit by 10% if we enable prefix/KV caching more aggressively? That could cut peak token load by ~12% on chat flows. Has anyone measured cache hit rate on recent sessions?

capacity_bot: daily_capacity_snapshot: {"reserved_tok_s": "9500", "burst_available_tok_s": "26000", "median_latency_ms": "82", "95p_latency_ms": "210"}  (scheduled report)

mateo_r: Cache hit rate around 18% last week on chat flows; devex rolling out improved conversation affinity which should push hit rate to ~30% in Q2. If true, we can safely lower commit further.

casey_ops: Cost/ops constraint: partner colo quoted 12-16 week lead on additional racks for EU. So any reserved increases need 3+ month runway for physical delivery. Rentals cover that gap but at higher $/hr.

alex_k: Proposal v1: commit 120 reserved (mixed fp16 + q4 quant buckets), increase caching + batching config (reduce target commit by 10% if cache hits > 25%), maintain burst rental budget to cover 40% of projected 95th pct. Also set regional commit skew: US 70%, EU 20%, APAC 10% initially.

priya_m: Sounds reasonable. Ask: how does this compare to straight 160 reserved buy? Quick delta?

mateo_r: Quick delta: 160 reserved ups capex/commit by ~33% vs 120. It flattens rental spend but increases fixed cost and worsens unit economics if tail never materializes. Financial breakeven depends on burst utilization >45% monthly.

jordan_r: Operational risk: bigger reserved buys increase model pinning complexity during rollouts. With 160 reserved we'll need stricter canary windows and more fallback routes. That slows deploy velocity. :warning:

casey_ops: Also inventory risk for APAC — vendors limited. If we commit to 160 we may be stuck with mismatched hardware in APAC and have to pay for cross-region traffic.

alex_k: Next steps: I'll run a 6-scenario sim (commit sizes 100/120/140/160 x burst 25/35/45) with cost, latency, regional constraints and send a short memo. If we agree on guardrails, ops can start rental vendor outreach this week.

priya_m: +1 to sim. Can you include a sensitivity to prefix-cache hit rate (18%, 25%, 35%) and a quantization adoption path?

mateo_r: I'll help with demand forecasts and event-driven spike modelling. Also will surface any enterprise onboarding that might change 95th pct.

capacity_bot: action_assigned: alex_k -> run sim by 2234568000; casey_ops -> confirm EU rack timeline by 2234568200

alex_k: thanks — I'll post sim results in this thread and drop a 15m sync after. :thumbsup:
